# Sprunki Characters

> > A comprehensive fan-created wiki and character database for the Sprunki Incredibox mod, featuring detailed guides for normal and horror mode characters.

Sprunki Characters is a community-driven encyclopedia dedicated to documenting all characters and gameplay modes in Sprunki, a popular mod of the music creation game Incredibox. The site provides character references, guides, and information in multiple languages including English, Korean, and Japanese.

## Core Character Guides

- [Sprunki Characters (Normal)](https://sprunkicharacters.org): Fan-created encyclopedia for Incredibox mod Sprunki with normal characters
- [Sprunki Characters (Horror)](https://sprunkicharacters.org/horror-characters): Character reference guide for horror mode in Sprunki with corrupted variants

## International Versions

- [Sprunki Characters (Japanese - Normal)](https://sprunkicharacters.org/ja): Japanese language fan encyclopedia for Sprunki normal characters
- [Sprunki Characters (Japanese - Horror)](https://sprunkicharacters.org/ja/horror-characters): Japanese language horror characters reference for Sprunki mod
- [Sprunki Characters (Korean - Normal)](https://sprunkicharacters.org/ko): Korean language fan encyclopedia for Sprunki normal characters
- [Sprunki Characters (Korean - Horror)](https://sprunkicharacters.org/ko/horror-characters): Korean language horror characters guide for Sprunki Incredibox mod
